diagram_math_checks.check: The same definition has r_alpha,k(x)=x-(B(x,alpha)-k)alpha^vee. def-coroot-and-dual-root-system gives alpha^vee=2 here, hence r_alpha,k=2k-x. Local steps 1.3 and 2.1 give s0=-x and s1=2-x. The left-pointing arrow starts at 1/2 and ends at -1/2; the right-pointing arrow starts at 1/2 and ends at 3/2. Thus s0(A0)=A_-1 and s1(A0)=A1, with fixed walls 0 and 1 respectively. The arrows are schematic midpoint images, as stated explicitly, not trajectories or additional walls.
